# Embedded QuickJS-NG

Vendored engine sources and headers from QuickJS-NG v0.18.0, commit
`d7215b0ad3fc2c562e8317fd9bca058fd4863804`:
https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/tree/d7215b0ad3fc2c562e8317fd9bca058fd4863804

MIT licensed; see LICENSE. Sources are unmodified. Slopfab builds the four engine
translation units as a static library and supplies its own workflow host APIs.
No qjs executable, Node.js, Python, or npm installation is used at runtime.
